status: offline modeled DMA payload bytes; not measured hardware traffic or execution time
scope: 74 learned Conv1d/ConvTranspose1d operators only, including their explicit input staging, bias loads and transpose scatter; excludes compiler prezero of operator output, instruction fetch, host upload/download, activation, LSTM, VQ and final tanh
method: Sum exact requested BF16 DMA payload lengths over geometric tiles. The im2col baseline models use_sram=False and the selected static/dynamic matmat tiling; the SRAM candidate models use_sram=True. Repeated transfers count every time; strided gaps do not count as payload.

assumptions.weight_strip: BF16 N strip bounded by SRAM-B and N*(K/64)<=4095; 64-aligned, with 32/16 fallback
assumptions.new_batch: Input decimated window and one padded output strip must jointly fit 524160-byte SRAM-A; each weight strip reused for every output row in the batch.
assumptions.dilation: Separate dilation/gcd(stride,dilation) time residues, with input step stride/gcd; window reads include repeated halos at tile boundaries.
assumptions.transpose: Exact polyphases are separate regular convolutions; baseline writes/reads temporary result then scatters, candidate directly scatters SRAM.
assumptions.bus_overhead: Does not model burst scheduling/command overhead, memory-controller efficiency, arithmetic latency, pipeline overlap or cache behavior; cannot infer speedup from bytes alone.
